name: Bonded Companion
text: You infuse your bonded item with magic, transforming it into a trusted companion. You gain a familiar. The type of an animal it is must be one that shares your natural affinity (such as a bat for an asterid or mole for a lampad). If your bonded companion is destroyed, it can be revived using a 24-hour ritual, instead of spending the typical week of downtime to replace it.
